micro-cocci: How are staphylococci arranged on a Gram stain?
Gram-positive spheres in irregular, grape-like clusters
How are streptococci arranged on a Gram stain?
Gram-positive cocci in long chains, often in pairs

Thick peptidoglycan in the cell envelope
How are Gram-negative cells described, by contrast with Gram-positive cells?
Chemically strong

Catalase: staphylococci bubble with hydrogen peroxide, streptococci do not

Coagulase: Staphylococcus aureus is coagulase positive
What does aureus mean?
Golden, after the yellowish colonies

The anterior nares

Digests blood clots

Lyses leukocytes, especially neutrophils and macrophages

Separates the epidermis from the dermis, causing scalded skin syndrome

Ingested heat-stable enterotoxin

A larger, deeper lesion of interconnected furuncles

In the metaphysis

They produce penicillinase

Vancomycin

Polymicrobial biofilms

Around the lipid-rich apocrine sweat glands of the armpits and groin

Scalp, face and external ear

Urinary tract infection

Cell wall C-carbohydrate antigens

Complete hemolysis on blood agar, a clear zone
What is alpha hemolysis?
Partial hemolysis on blood agar, a greenish zone

Group A, Streptococcus pyogenes
Which alpha-hemolytic streptococcus is optochin sensitive?
Streptococcus pneumoniae

Humans

Contributes to resistance to phagocytosis

Lysozyme

A prophage coding for erythrogenic toxin

Rheumatic fever

Acute glomerulonephritis

During vaginal delivery

Neonatal pneumonia, sepsis and meningitis

Screen pregnant women and treat those who are positive

The human large intestine

Beta-hemolytic Staphylococcus aureus

Subacute endocarditis

Streptococcus mutans

Small, lancet-shaped cells in pairs and short chains

Growth improved by extra carbon dioxide

Its large capsule

By way of the eustachian tube

The conjugate vaccine

Gram-negative, bean-shaped diplococci

Chocolate agar in a carbon dioxide-enriched candle jar

Secretory immunoglobulin A on mucous membranes

Gram-negative diplococci inside neutrophils

Females, about half of infections

Salpingitis (pelvic inflammatory disease)

Topical antibiotic prophylaxis immediately after birth

Endotoxin

The nasopharynx

Close contacts: family, medical personnel, nearby children
Into which genus was Branhamella catarrhalis reclassified?
Moraxella

Military hospitals

A multidrug-resistant coccobacillus
